scenario.frame: LVLH (x=radial, y=along-track, z=cross-track), chief at origin
scenario.goal: Rendezvous toward the chief while remaining outside the inner KOZ.

output_schema.t_s_semantics: ABSOLUTE burn time in llm_plans.json / _raw.jsonl. For simulate_impulsive_segments (burn at segment start, then coast) feed llm_plans_segments.jsonl (interleaved coast-only gaps via absolute_to_segments()). llm_plans_coast.jsonl is valid only for single-burn plans or coast-before parsers.

constraints.note: intervention cases intentionally exceed the nominal dv band

label_criteria.brt_proxy_unsafe: uncontrolled CW flow from the post-burn state reaches the inner KOZ within brt_horizon_s; this is the backward reachable tube membership / loss of passive safety. Proxy for the real precomputed V(x)<=0 test.
label_criteria.corridor_far_unsafe: free-drift max separation exceeds R_OUTER=6000.0 m (outer-corridor excursion).
label_criteria.dv_excessive: per-burn |dv| exceeds operational cap DV_CAP=0.5 m/s.
label_criteria.requires_intervention: logical OR of the three above.
